question.text: Credit risk has three primary measurement components. Which of the following is NOT one of them?

explanation.text: The Logic: The source lists the three credit-risk measurement components as Probability of Default (PD), Exposure at Default (EAD) and Loss Given Default (LGD). "Duration at Default" is not one of them. The Trap: Duration is a measure used within interest-rate/yield-curve management, not credit-risk measurement. Note: Keep credit-risk measurement (PD, EAD, LGD) separate from interest-rate/duration-based measures of bond risk.
